Play Cozy Grove now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cozy-grove-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01 

Welcome to Cozy Grove, a life-sim game about camping on a haunted, ever-changing island. As a Spirit Scout, you'll wander the island's forest each day, finding hidden secrets and helping soothe the local ghosts. With a little time and a lot of crafting, you'll bring color and joy back to your island!

author: Nintendo of America
description:
Dark Scrolls comes to Nintendo Switch in 2026! 

Dark Scrolls is a fantasy-themed action platformer with roguelite progression, packed with charm, challenge, and secrets. Set forth on your quest with quirky heroes in solo or cooperative play, local and online. Hack, slash, and dodge through hordes of enemies and deadly traps in procedurally generated runs of hand-crafted rooms and levels using each hero's unique attacks and abilities to your advantage.
